newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds fell in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds fell in week.

text.p: Total money market mutual fund assets in the week Thursday fell to $963.62 billion from $969.46 billion the prior week, an industry trade group said.

The Investment Company Institute said assets of the nation's 664 retail money market mutual funds fell $1.50 billion to $642.26 billion in the week. Of the retail funds, assets of the 403 taxable money market funds fell $1.23 billion to $527.63 billion, while assets of the 261 tax-exempt funds fell $265.2 million to $114.63 billion, the group said.

ICI said assets of the 324 institutional money market funds fell $4.34 billion to $321.36 billion. Of these, assets of the 262 taxable money market funds decreased $4.57 billion to $287.31 billion, while assets of the 62 tax-exempt funds grew $228.6 million to $34.05 billion, it said.
